meta.name: qodo-pr-resolver
meta.description: Review and resolve PR issues with Qodo - get AI-powered code review issues and fix them interactively (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps)

copy.tagline: 审查并交互式修复代码审查问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要审查PR并修复代码问题
copy.tagline_en: Review and fix code review issues interactively
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often review PRs and fix code issues

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能获取当前分支 PR 的 Qodo 代码审查问题，逐个或批量修复，并回复每条内联评论。
howto.when: 当你在 Git 仓库中，当前分支有已由 Qodo 审查过的开放 PR，且你说出“查看 Qodo 问题”、“修复 Qodo 评论”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我看看这个 PR 的 Qodo 审查问题。
say.note: Claude 会获取并显示问题列表。

say.text: 自动修复所有 Qodo 指出的问题。
say.note: Claude 会批量应用修复并提交。

say.text: 逐个审查 Qodo 的代码建议。
say.note: Claude 会逐一展示并让你决定是否修复。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can fetch Qodo review issues for the current branch's PR, fix them interactively or in batch, and reply to each inline comment with the decision.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you are in a git repository with an open PR reviewed by Qodo, and you mention keywords like "view Qodo issues" or "fix Qodo comments".

say_en.text: Show me the Qodo review issues for this PR.
say_en.note: Claude will fetch and display the issues.
Claude will apply all fixes and commit.

say_en.text: Review each Qodo suggestion one by one.
say_en.note: Claude will show each issue for your approval.
